name: Gross Body Coordination
definition: The ability to coordinate the movement of your arms, legs, and torso together when the whole body is in motion.

benchmark.name: DeepMind Control Suite
benchmark.metric: mean episode return on humanoid:run (0-1000 scale)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population. Gross body coordination for walking and running is a general ability, not a specialist one.

benchmark.name: DeepMind Control Suite
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce. Gross body coordination (running, balance recovery, whole-body movement) is a broadly held ability, and most workers performing physical tasks have it at a basic level.

benchmark.name: DeepMind Control Suite
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing whole-body motor tasks (walking, running, lifting, climbing, balancing while moving), e.g., manual and physical-labor workers

benchmark.name: HumanoidBench
benchmark.metric: per-task maximum episode return (task-specific scale, each task has its own success target)

benchmark.name: HumanoidBench
benchmark.metric: mean success-normalized score across the 14 h1hand tasks, as a percentage: (return - random) / (task success threshold - random) x 100. The paper reports 0.534, 95% CI [0.473, 0.595].
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing whole-body physical work (e.g., laborers, warehouse staff, construction workers) whose jobs require walking, running, crawling, climbing stairs, hurdling, balancing and whole-body manipulation.
